see - https://lore.kernel.org/linux-mm/62bf02dc-dab1-41bf-8204-eb3566628b93@nvidia.com/

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch refactors the find_next_best_node() function to find_next_best_node_in(), which takes an explicit candidates nodemask instead of relying on N_MEMORY. This change enables building fallback lists with non-N_MEMORY candidates, but does not introduce any functional changes as callers still select from N_MEMORY. The refactor affects three files: mm/internal.h, mm/memory-tiers.c, and mm/page_alloc.c.
